overview.description: The Vanguard Morningstar Mega Cap Growth ETF (MGK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of mega-cap stocks in the US. Holdings are selected and weighed based on growth factors. MGK was launched on Dec 17, 2007 and is issued by Vanguard.
